title: List views: readers can hide and show columns by default — flip the userActions.hideFields default, so a generated app has the control without having to declare it
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed by the record-page epic seat from a second console review under epic #26676. An independent reviewer walked the console on `main` `bdb19ca6d9`, with `examples/app-crm` as the backend, at 1440 and 390 px. The seat then re-read the evidence. The maintainer approved the seat's checked list: 「Fable 评估（核对后） 同意立卡」 (2026-11-02). Code readings below are on `main` `5e1b9b0a77`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Observed

The list's Display menu offers open mode, grouping, density, row numbers and inline edit. Nothing there or on a column header hides a column. A reader cannot remove a column they do not need, and `examples/app-crm` and generated apps do not turn the control on.

## Reading

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1847`: `showHideFields: ua?.hideFields === true`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:1921`: `hideFields` defaults to `false`.
- The comment at `view.zod.ts:1882-1888` records this as copied from the renderer's legacy reads, not as a product choice.

The seat recommended flipping the default, and the maintainer's approval above is that decision.

## Target

1. `hideFields` defaults on in the schema and in the renderer: `ua?.hideFields !== false`. An app can still set `false`.
2. No new key.
3. Record the changed default the way `packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts` requires, and update the comment at `view.zod.ts:1882-1888`.

### Premise to verify first

The control that `hideFields: true` draws today works end to end: it hides a column, and on a view that stores the choice (see the acceptance below), the choice survives a reload. If it does not, report that first. Flipping the default would otherwise put a broken control on every list.

## Acceptance

- A view that does not declare `hideFields` offers the control.
- A view that declares `false` does not.
- On a view that declares `columns`, or a saved view, a hidden column stays hidden after a reload, for that reader only.
- On a system view that declares no `columns`, hiding lasts for the session only, under the objectui#10694 ruling (`persistHiddenFields`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx`, around line 373). This card does not change that.
- The spec default, the renderer read and the default-change record agree.

---

Acceptance narrowed by the epic seat. The maintainer: 「把「恢复默认清除偏好」、「账号偏好字段校验」、「个性化标记与统一重置」立卡，并收窄 #28912 的验收。」 (2026-11-02). The earlier text said every hidden column survives a reload, which the seat had read too widely.
